name: Depleted Uranium Alloy
description: Uranium with most of its fissile U-235 removed, leaving a metal denser than lead with self-sharpening properties under impact. DU penetrator rods punch through armor by shedding material in a way that keeps the tip sharp. Controversial due to radioactive dust contamination, DU remains in military arsenals where maximum penetration is non-negotiable.
story_hooks: A cache of DU penetrator rounds has gone missing from a military depot — the radioactive signature makes them trackable but also makes the search urgent.
